data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 and SCR_002 share a mechanism: the transition from concurrency (8 pieces) to general position (11 pieces) is governed by whether 'passing through the exact center' is read as strict concurrence or approximate near-concurrence. SRC_002 inherits the combinatorial formula n(n+1)/2 + 1, and SCR_002 maps the semantic ambiguity of 'exact' to the mathematical bifurcation. This is REFUTED IF the offset interpretation yields a piece count other than 11 for four lines — for example, if paired offsets produce parallelism that reduces the count below 11 — since then a single formula cannot cover the mechanism.
